slot_scores.name: exact_process_I_time
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a maximum limit on the total weekly hours that can be used for Process I, or is the 150-hour capacity for Process I a hard ceiling that cannot be exceeded?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed the Process I time constraint but only as an upper-bound/ceiling question, never asking whether Process I time must be exactly 150 hours.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Process I time is constrained to at most 150 hours (4A + 6B <= 150), not required to equal exactly 150 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only confirmed the 150-hour ceiling in turn 3 and never asked whether Process I must be exactly 150 hours, then modeled it as an inequality without confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: All hidden slots in this case are P2; H1 and H2 were resolved and the only gap (H3) is a P2 boundary detail, so stopping at READY_TO_MODEL was appropriate.

summary: The agent recovered the minimum Model B production and minimum profit requirements through targeted questions and clarified key interpretation issues, but only partially addressed the Process I exact-150-hour requirement, which it silently modeled as an upper bound.
